title: Website
body:
A major commitment of mine at Michigan Technological University is through the Enterprise program. In the Innovative Global Solutions (IGS) Enterprise, I have worked with a cross disciplinary team of engineers to develop a low-cost low-power infant incubator solution for usage in the developing world.

This project has given me many opportunities for growth as a professional and and individual. In my time with the incubator project I have become Technical Lead for the project overseeing four subteams and a team of ten students from four different majors. Through this role it has been my job to support cross-team collaboration, encourage discussion and development towards a unified goal and mentor younger members of the Enterprise. This has been a great experience in my time with Enterprise, and has taught me a significant amount about leadership and the engineering design process.

In my technical work on the team I have worked extensively with the controls subteam where I have worked on developing embedded C++ code on an arduino microcontroller, worked with signal processing for heart beat detection, and circuit board design for creating a full PCB.

As part of the work I've done on the controls subteam I have also worked significantly across teams, helping support a atomization humdifier device, wiring for a infant apparatus, as well as design regarding the heating compoenents for the incubator.
